docs.title: Components
docs.text:
• Frontend (Vite/React): UI, tooltips linking to Parameters Catalog.
  • Backend (Node/Express): routes for pools, graph, strategies, execution.
  • arb-rs (Rust): optional fast pathfinding/execution support.

docs.title: Data
docs.text:
• Liquidity sources: Raydium/Orca/Meteora/Drift.
  • Graph: normalized pools → snapshot → diff → pathfinding.
  • Pricing/slippage: simulation before execution; guards at send.

docs.title: Realtime
docs.text:
• Socket.IO events for tx lifecycle and feeds.
  • Logs streamed for sim/send/fill diagnostics.

docs.title: Integrations
docs.text:
• Jupiter/DEX SDKs for routing and quotes.
  • Drift SDK for perps, liquidator, leveraged grid.

docs.title: Arbitrage
docs.text:
1. Pool discovery/refresh per source (timers/websockets).
  2. Normalize pools → build graph snapshot.
  3. Find candidate routes; apply minProfitBps.
  4. Simulate with slippage; estimate fees and impact.
  5. Execute with risk caps (slippage, notional, hops).
  6. Emit tx events; record fills; update history.

docs.title: Drift
docs.text:
1. Market data (ladders, funding) fetched.
  2. Strategy decides placements based on presets.
  3. Orders placed under leverage/liq buffers.
  4. Monitor fills and risk; pause on guards.

docs.title: Principles
docs.text:
• Protect first: caps on slippage and notional.
  • Prefer simplicity: fewer hops reduce failure risk.
  • Progressive disclosure: presets before manual tuning.

docs.title: Presets rationale
docs.text:
• Safe: discovery, low exposure, tight guards.
  • Balanced: daily operation, moderate risk/throughput.
  • Aggressive: capture scarce alpha; requires close monitoring.

docs.title: Tuning
docs.text:
• Raise minProfitBps when volatility inflates impact.
  • Lower notionalCap in thin markets.
  • Adjust gridStepPercent to match range/trend regime.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Open Strategies → select Threshold or Grid.
  2. Choose Safe preset to start.
  3. Set maxSlippageBps 25–50, notionalCap $100–$500.
  4. Simulate and review expected PnL, fees, and slippage.
  5. Adjust minProfitBps or slippage if no viable routes.
  6. Execute in sim; validate logs.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Tight slippage → order rejections; widen slightly.
  • High minProfit → no routes; lower cautiously.
  • Large notional in illiquid pools → bad fills; reduce.

docs.title: Parameters Catalog
docs.text: Use anchors (copy link) to reference parameters from the UI tooltips.

docs.title: Cooldown between trades (ms) (cooldownMs)
docs.text: Type: integer:ms • Default: 2000 • Min: 0 • Max: 60000 Purpose: Avoid spamming orders in bursts. When to change: Increase if markets are choppy; decrease if opportunities are fleeting. Risks: Too short causes churn; too long misses windows.

docs.title: Recommended ranges
docs.text:
• stable: 500–2000
  • volatile: 1000–5000

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
• Safe: 3000
  • Aggressive: 500 Used by: threshold, grid

docs.title: Max slippage (maxSlippageBps)
docs.text: Type: integer:bps • Default: 50 • Min: 0 • Max: 300 Purpose: Cap price impact on fills. When to change: Increase for volatile/illiquid markets; decrease in tight markets. Risks: Too low rejects trades; too high causes bad fills. Rationale: Balance fill probability vs adverse selection.

docs.title: Recommended ranges
docs.text:
• stable: 10–30
  • volatile: 40–100

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
• Stable pools: 15 bps
  • Volatile: 75 bps Used by: threshold, grid

docs.title: Max notional per trade (USD) (notionalCap)
docs.text: Type: number:usd • Default: 500 • Min: 0 • Max: 100000 Purpose: Limit exposure per fill. When to change: Increase with strong liquidity and confidence; decrease when testing. Risks: Too high concentrates risk; too low increases missed opportunities.

docs.title: Recommended ranges
docs.text:
• stable: 250–1,000
  • volatile: 100–500

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
• Safe: 100
  • Balanced: 500
  • Aggressive: 2000 Used by: threshold, grid

docs.title: Grid step percent (gridStepPercent)
docs.text: Type: number:percent • Default: 0.5 • Min: 0.05 • Max: 5 Purpose: Price spacing between grid levels. When to change: Increase in high volatility; decrease in tight ranges. Risks: Too small overtrades; too large misses trades.

docs.title: Recommended ranges
docs.text:
• stable: 0.25–0.75
  • volatile: 0.75–2.0

docs.title: Examples
docs.text: • Balanced: 0.5% Used by: grid

docs.title: Minimum target profit (minProfitBps)
docs.text: Type: integer:bps • Default: 20 • Min: 0 • Max: 500 Purpose: Discard routes below this net profit. When to change: Increase if slippage is high; decrease if fills are rare. Risks: Too high misses profitable routes; too low captures noise.

docs.title: Recommended ranges
docs.text:
• stable: 10–30
  • volatile: 30–80

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
• Stable: 20
  • Volatile: 50 Used by: threshold

docs.title: Max route hops (maxHops)
docs.text: Type: integer • Default: 3 • Min: 1 • Max: 6 Purpose: Cap path complexity to control execution risk. When to change: Increase if liquidity fragmented; decrease to reduce failure surface. Risks: More hops increase slippage + failure probability.

docs.title: Recommended ranges
docs.text:
• stable: 2–3
  • volatile: 2–4

docs.title: Examples
docs.text: • Balanced: 3 Used by: threshold

docs.title: Error Codes
docs.text:
Code Meaning Likely Cause Fix REJECTION_SLIPPAGE Order rejected due to slippage guard maxSlippageBps too low for liquidity/volatility Increase slippage within recommended ranges ROUTE_NOT_FOUND No viable path found Min profit too high; disabled sources; hop cap too low Lower minProfitBps, enable sources, raise maxHops INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY Pool depth too low for size Notional too high; fragmented liquidity Lower notionalCap; allow more hops RPC_RATE_LIMIT RPC throttling Provider limits exceeded Add cooldownMs; use higher-tier RPC WALLET_FUNDS_LOW Not enough SOL/USDC Fees/collateral not covered Fund wallet; lower size SIGNATURE_REJECTED User denied wallet signature User cancelled or wallet locked Re-open wallet and approve TX_TOO_LARGE Transaction size exceeded Too many hops/instructions Reduce hops; split trade TIMEOUT Submission/confirmation took too long Network congestion Retry with backoff; monitor RPC PRICE_FEED_STALE Quotes not updating Feed outage / network Wait or switch feed/RPC

See also: - Troubleshooting - Parameter guards: maxSlippageBps, notionalCap, maxHops

docs.title: Adverse Selection
docs.text: Fills when price moves against you during execution.

docs.title: Bps
docs.text: Basis points; 1 bps = 0.01%.

docs.title: Cool‑down
docs.text: Pause before next order to reduce churn.

docs.title: Hop
docs.text: One swap leg in a multi-pool route.

docs.title: Liquidity
docs.text: Depth available at or near the current price.

docs.title: Notional
docs.text: Gross USD value of a trade.

docs.title: Preset
docs.text: Named bundle of recommended parameter values.

docs.title: Route
docs.text: A sequence of pools/exchanges for execution.

docs.title: Slippage
docs.text: Difference between expected and executed price.

docs.title: Spread
docs.text: Difference between best bid and best ask.

docs.title: Orders rejected
docs.text:
Checks: - Increase maxSlippageBps within recommended range. - Verify liquidity feeds are fresh. - Reduce notionalCap in low-liquidity markets.

See also: - ../parameters/catalog.md#maxSlippageBps - ../reference/error-codes.md

docs.title: No routes found
docs.text:
Checks: - Increase maxHops slightly. - Enable more liquidity sources. - Lower minProfitBps threshold.

See also: - ../parameters/catalog.md#maxHops - ../parameters/catalog.md#minProfitBps

docs.title: Bad fills (high slippage)
docs.text:
Checks: - Lower maxSlippageBps. - Lower notionalCap. - Avoid volatile pairs; check pool depth.

See also: - ../parameters/catalog.md#maxSlippageBps - ../parameters/catalog.md#notionalCap

docs.title: TL;DR
docs.text:
• Discover profitable routes across sources, simulate, then execute.
  • Start with safe defaults; raise risk gradually.
  • Monitor fills and slippage; adjust caps and profit threshold.

docs.title: Safe defaults
docs.text:
• maxSlippageBps: 25–50 bps
  • notionalCap: $100–$500
  • minProfitBps: 20–30 bps
  • maxHops: 2–3
  • cooldownMs: 1000–3000 ms

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Enable desired liquidity sources (Jupiter/Raydium/Orca/Meteora).
  2. Set risk caps and profitability threshold.
  3. Simulate candidate routes; verify net profit after fees and slippage.
  4. Execute, monitor fills, and review logs.

docs.title: Key parameters
docs.text:
• Max slippage (maxSlippageBps): cap price impact to avoid adverse fills.
  • Max notional (notionalCap): limit per-trade exposure.
  • Min profit (minProfitBps): discard low-ev routes.
  • Max hops (maxHops): constrain route complexity.
  • Cooldown (cooldownMs): prevent rapid-fire retries.

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
• Safe: maxSlippageBps=25, notionalCap=$100, minProfitBps=30, maxHops=2
  • Balanced: maxSlippageBps=50, notionalCap=$500, minProfitBps=20, maxHops=3
  • Aggressive: maxSlippageBps=100, notionalCap=$2000, minProfitBps=10, maxHops=4

docs.title: Common pitfalls
docs.text:
• Orders rejected: slippage too tight for current liquidity.
  • Negative PnL: minProfit too low in volatile markets; increase threshold.
  • Route failures: too many hops; reduce complexity or widen slippage modestly.

docs.title: TL;DR
docs.text:
• Trade via Drift with risk caps and controlled slippage.
  • Start in simulation; move to live only after verifying fills.

docs.title: Safe defaults
docs.text:
• maxSlippageBps: 25–50 bps
  • notionalCap: $100–$500
  • cooldownMs: 1000–3000 ms

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Connect wallet and verify balances.
  2. Choose order type and set risk caps.
  3. Simulate; review expected fills and risk.
  4. Execute with small notional; review logs.

docs.title: Key parameters
docs.text:
• Max slippage: protect fills.
  • Max notional: bound exposure.
  • Cooldown: dampen burst trading.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Overfills in volatile markets → lower notionalCap and slippage.
  • Rejections from stale prices → confirm feed freshness and retry.

docs.title: Views
docs.text:
• Live stream: execution, simulation, errors.
  • Filters: by severity, strategy, source.

docs.title: Common events
docs.text:
• sim.ok / sim.err: simulation outcome.
  • send.ok / send.err: transaction submission.
  • fill: expected vs executed size/price.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• Filter to errors to diagnose rejections.
  • Compare sim vs fill slippage.
  • Export logs when reporting issues.

docs.title: Connect
docs.text:
• Use the Connect Wallet button in the app.
  • Verify network and address before proceeding.

docs.title: Balances & tokens
docs.text:
• View supported tokens and balances.
  • Ensure sufficient SOL for fees (and collateral for Drift).

docs.title: Safety
docs.text:
• Approvals: grant minimal permissions.
  • Spending caps: start low; raise gradually as confidence grows.
  • Cold vs hot: prefer funded sub-accounts for testing.

docs.title: Operational checks
docs.text:
• Confirm RPC health and recent slot.
  • Verify price feeds are updating in the UI.
  • Keep a small SOL buffer for retries.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• Insufficient funds → fund wallet and reduce notional.
  • Signature declined → re-open wallet, re-approve.
  • RPC rate limit → switch RPC or throttle via cooldown.

docs.title: Strategy Chooser
docs.text:
• Threshold: event-driven arb with min profit filter.
  • Grid: range-trading with spaced orders.

See individual pages for presets and tuning.
